name: param
description: Parameter: the high-level control used by the app or the AI ("happiness", "head_turn", "mouth"). It does nothing by itself: drivers connect it to poses. Its value is not stored in the document; it is set by whoever uses the character (the editor with its controls, the preview with params).
help: High-level control used by the app or the AI. Drivers connect it to poses; its value is not saved.

kind.help: number = a value between min and max; boolean = 0 or 1; enum = one of the options.
kind.description: number = a value between min and max; boolean = 0 or 1; enum = one of options (text).

options.help: Options of an enum, for example rest, a, e, o, m.
options.description: Options of an enum, for example ["rest", "a", "e", "o", "m"].

initial.help: Initial option of an enum (empty = the first one).
initial.description: Initial option of an enum (null = the first one).

description.help: What it controls, in a few words. The app's AI reads it in the manifest.
description.description: What it controls, in a few words (in English if the app is in English). The app's AI reads it in the manifest.
